shared_elements: horizontal band or row of repeated short strokes
simple geometric divisions or marks within larger forms
justification: The most specific shared content is a horizontal, comb-like band of repeated short marks placed above or among more schematic figures. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a single large standing anthropomorphic form with a circular/quartered body or head element, while B is a crowded multi-register composition of many separate animal-like and abstract motifs with no comparable central figure.
